title: Virtual Legal Assistant of the Rights Mapping and Analysis Platform (RiMAP) to Improve Legal Analysis and Access to Rights and Solutions for Forcibly Displaced and Stateless Persons
summary: UNHCR is developing an assistant to collect, summarize, and analyze laws affecting displaced and stateless people. Research-time savings remain a target.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: UNHCR is developing an internal prototype that collects, summarizes, and analyzes laws affecting displaced and stateless people. Research-time savings remain a target.
purpose: Help legal advisers maintain and analyze information about displaced people's rights.
location: Intended coverage: legal frameworks across UN countries and territories

ratings.reason: UNHCR editors and legal advisers are intended to save research time; no observed operational gain is supplied.
Displaced and stateless people are intended to gain access to legal information; no individual rights or service outcome is documented.
More inclusive legal frameworks are an intended downstream benefit, not a recorded policy change.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 11: Virtual Legal Assistant of the Rights Mapping and Analysis Platform (RiMAP) to Improve Legal Analysis and Access to Rights and Solutions for Forcibly Displaced and Stateless Persons

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Access to relevant legal documents and local language models
Human review of generated legal summaries

headline: UNHCR prototypes a virtual legal assistant
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
